identity.name: Bobbie Clarke
identity.summary: English drummer of early British rock and roll, best remembered with Vince Taylor and the Playboys, later in Bodast and in France.

contribution.description: Taught by the jazz drummer Eric Delaney, he drummed for Vince Taylor and His Playboys and later the groundbreaking Bodast, and critics regard him as an important figure in early British rock and roll.

beatbreaker.group: Rock and roll and roots drummers
beatbreaker.songs_short_because: 15-b sweep (2026-10-22): Bobbie Clarke is remembered for one record; his later work in France and with Johnny Hallyday is not credited track by track in the sources.

evidence.note: Before Deep Purple's first record (the repo's Paice record names him).
